title: Wars V (Gothic War I), chapter 19
version: Loeb Classical Library volume III, 1919; LacusCurtius transcription.
lineage: Sixth-century narrative by a participant in Belisarius’s campaign, read through a public-domain 1919 translation. I.19.8–28 inspected in full, plus I.14.14 and chronology framing. No archaeological verification of the boat installation or literal city-wide flour sufficiency. Date conversion is checked with Bury below; it is the same narrative lineage.

passages.quote: much water is brought by an aqueduct
passages.note: Identifies the operating supply of Rome’s pre-siege hill mills.

passages.quote: the mechanism by which mills are customarily turned
passages.note: After loss of aqueduct power, Belisarius applies customary mill machinery between moored boats.
A chain barrier and removal crew intercept debris; continued use of mills is reported, with defence against boats also an explicit purpose.
